# FireRescue1

> FireRescue1 is the leading digital platform for fire rescue professionals, delivering breaking news, expert resources, product intelligence, and community engagement across the fire service industry.

FireRescue1 serves as a comprehensive hub for firefighters, fire chiefs, and fire service organizations with curated news coverage, expert columnists, training webinars, downloadable resources, and an extensive product directory featuring fire apparatus, communications systems, dispatch technology, and emergency response equipment. The platform emphasizes firefighter wellness, leadership development, and occupational safety through original content, podcasts, and research-backed insights.

## News & Breaking Coverage

- [Fire News](https://www.firerescue1.com/news): Breaking fire rescue news covering incidents, LODD, and fire service
- [Most Popular Articles](https://www.firerescue1.com/most-popular-fire-articles): Curated popular articles on firefighter safety, wellness, and apparatus
- [Better Every Shift Podcast](https://www.firerescue1.com/better-every-shift): FireRescue1 podcast on firefighter wellness and fire service

## Products & Equipment Directory

- [FireRescue1 Product Guide](https://www.firerescue1.com/fire-products): Comprehensive product guide for fire rescue equipment and technology
- [Product Category Directory](https://www.firerescue1.com/product-category-directory): Indexed directory of fire rescue product categories
- [Apparatus & Specialty Vehicles](https://www.firerescue1.com/fire-products/apparatus-specialty-vehicles): Fire apparatus and specialty vehicle products and specifications
- [Communications](https://www.firerescue1.com/fire-products/communications): Fire communications systems, radios, and dispatch technology
- [Dispatch, Call Centers & 911](https://www.firerescue1.com/fire-products/dispatch-call-centers-911): Dispatch systems, CAD software, and 911 call center technology
- [Drones](https://www.firerescue1.com/fire-products/drones): Unmanned aircraft systems and drones for fire rescue operations
- [Company Directory](https://www.firerescue1.com/company-directory): Directory of fire safety equipment manufacturers and vendors
